svg.font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: NCCL collectives, before and after
svg.desc: Seven panels with four ranks each show what every rank holds before and after AllReduce, Broadcast, Reduce, AllGather, ReduceScatter, AlltoAll, and point-to-point send and receive, with the JAX primitive that lowers to each one. NCCL notes that ReduceScatter followed by AllGather, or Reduce followed by Broadcast, equals an AllReduce. A ring AllReduce on four ranks takes three reduce-scatter steps and three all-gather steps, so each rank sends 2(n−1)/n of the buffer, and with the two GPUs in the post each rank sends half the buffer twice.
